endpoints.description: Configuration of Prometheus or Grafana endpoints to check for alerts.

uri.description: The URI to the Prometheus alerts API or Grafana datasources API.

datasource.description: If the URI is a Grafana proxy, this is the name of the Prometheus datasource to use, otherwise leave empty.

header.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with the request (e.g., for Authorization).

name.description: The name of the HTTP header.

content.description: The content/value of the HTTP header.

ignore-alerts.description: List of alert names to ignore for this endpoint.

watchdog-alerts.description: List of alerts that are expected to be always firing (watchdogs). If they stop firing, it's considered an error. Watchdog can be disabled with the string "disabled".

command-line.description: Configuration for executing a shell command when alert status changes.

shell-command.description: The full path to the shell script or command to execute.

darkmode.description: Manually set the desired mode (true for dark mode). If not set, the application tries to detect it automatically.
